question: Which versions of this decision matrix are enabled, and what rows does the enabled one hold?

steps.name: versions
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Name, VersionNumber, IsEnabled, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, LastModifiedDate FROM CalculationMatrixVersion WHERE CalculationMatrix.Name = '{name}' ORDER BY VersionNumber DESC

steps.name: rows
steps.soql: SELECT InputData, OutputData FROM CalculationMatrixRow WHERE CalculationMatrixVersion.CalculationMatrix.Name = '{name}' AND CalculationMatrixVersion.IsEnabled = true LIMIT 2000

traps: An enabled matrix is not proof it runs. Confirm an active process looks it up before treating it as live.
